g.text: Find and review a listing (REQ-004-1/2/3/4)
The Admin area row reads "Listings" with
"2 waiting for approval" or "Nothing waiting".
Someone opens "Listings" in the Admin area
(or the address of a listing's Admin view)
Redirect to log in, then
return to the page asked for
no
Logged in?
yes
The same holds for every action: a non-Admin who
tries to approve, reject, take down or Admin-edit
by any means is refused and the listing is unchanged.
Refuse — send home with a message
no
Admin?
yes
Show "Waiting for approval" first (the approval queue),
with the number waiting next to it. Choices: Waiting for
approval, Published, Needs changes, Taken down, Closed — no Draft
Admin chooses another status?
yes
no
Show Published, Needs changes, Taken down
or Closed listings, most recently changed first
Drafts are never listed.
A withdrawn listing leaves the queue.
The Admin's own listings say "Your listing".
Waiting counts from the latest submission.
An Admin edit does not move a listing.
Show waiting listings,
longest-waiting first
Say so in one plain sentence
no
Any listings with that status?
yes
The chosen status is part of the address,
so "Back" from a listing returns to the same list.
Show 50 rows at a time, more on request: title,
business name, region, salary range, how long ago
Admin taps a row (or came straight to the
listing's address, e.g. from the email)
Not found
no
Listing exists and is not a Draft?
yes
Show status, who posted it (business name,
account email), when it was submitted,
and "Your listing" if it is the Admin's own
Show the latest decision: what, when,
by which Admin, and the reason if any
(none after a resubmission, until the next decision)
Show the listing as visitors will see it
Mark the region "hidden"
Say it cannot be approved as it is, and how to go on:
show the region again, change the region (Edit),
or reject with a reason. Approve is still offered
yes
Pending approval?
no
yes
Its region is hidden?
no
Say in one plain sentence what the main
action will do (approving, or taking down)
Status
Offer Approve, Reject, Edit
Offer Take down, Edit
Read-only — no actions
Pending approval
Rejected, Closed,
Taken down
Published
